scope: Cross-request tool/no-progress loops. An independent attempt is positive once; iterations or multiple loop motifs do not multiply its count. Single-response thinking repetition separately noted.
selected_candidate: Commit Audit original complete reviewer scenario
selection_basis: Strict unchanged/no-progress evidence: Commit Audit at least3 independent cross-request tool-loop observations; Spec merged scene1 explicit loop plus3 suspected stagnation cases. Do not count generic duplicate calls or delayed writes as confirmed loops. Counts are report-based lower bounds, not a complete global incidence ranking.

limitations: Historical versions, efforts, capacities, prompt conditions and protocol differ; do not estimate one current-setting loop rate from pooled observations.
